snippet.title: Financial Historian
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Financial Historian, where money, power, and history collide.

Here, history is the starting point. We explore how financial systems formed, how wealth moved through empires, and how decisions made decades or centuries ago still shape the world today.

Through economic history and clear financial storytelling, this channel breaks down how money actually works: how value is created, how power concentrates, and how financial systems quietly influence everyday life. From ancient debt cycles to modern markets, every episode uses the past to bring clarity to the present.

This is a place for viewers who want context and depth, not just headlines.

And to be clear: this is the ONLY official Financial Historian channel.
Anything else is not affiliated.

For inquiries or collaborations: info@dyffjproductions.com

If this gave you a new perspective, hit subscribe.
History has the answers, and I’ll show you where to look. 👊🏼🫵🏼🔥

snippet.title: Dan Malone
snippet.description:
Dan Malone is an Irish Chartered Accountant (ACA), Chartered Tax Advisor (CTA) and holder of the Qualified Financial Adviser (QFA) designation. With over a decade of experience in personal finance, Dan is on a mission to bring free, high-quality and trusted financial guidance to every household in Ireland. 

Dan is the founder of honest.ie, Ireland's #1 trusted source for financial information and the only unbiased product comparison platform for savings. The site offers comprehensive yet easy-to-understand educational guides as well as market-leading comparison tools and calculators to the people of Ireland - completely free of charge.

Dan is a regular contributor to the Irish Independent's money section, having published over 20+ articles and holds a first-class honours Bachelor of Commerce and Masters in Accounting from University College Dublin.

snippet.title: Survival Curriculum
snippet.description:
Fictional Disasters. Real Science. The Survival Curriculum.

I’m Tom. I turn fictional scenarios—from zombie outbreaks to nuclear winters—into actionable, science-based survival lessons. While most channels focus on gear, we focus on the logic of collapse.

🎓 The Curriculum:

Science of Fiction: Real physics & biology applied to scenarios.

Tactical Analysis: How to survive the first 24 hours.

Real Preparedness: Actionable skills for real-world emergencies.

🤖 Production Note: This channel utilizes AI tools to assist with visualization and narration, but every single video is originally researched, scripted, directed, and manually edited by me, Tom. This is a human-led project dedicated to high-quality educational storytelling.

👇 Join the Class: Subscribe to equip yourself for the end of the world (or just your next power outage).

🎒 Official Supply Depot:https://survivalcurriculum.com 🛠️ Recommended Gear: https://amzn.to/3MmxUQA

localized.description:
Animation videos explaining things with optimistic nihilism since 12,013.

We’re a team of illustrators, animators, number crunchers and one dog who aim to spark curiosity about science and the world we live in. To us nothing is boring if you tell a good story.

For updates on our videos and other news from the kurzgesagt universe follow us on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.

snippet.title: Patrick Boyle
snippet.description:
Patrick Boyle is a hedge fund manager, a university professor and a former investment banker. 

This channel is all about quantitative finance. By subscribing you will see videos explaining what is happening in markets right now, you will learn about financial derivatives, corporate finance and how traders use quantitative tools like statistics. You will see interviews with some of the most interesting people in the financial industry.  In addition, you will see some longer form documentaries on the history of financial markets.

To contact Patrick go to the website http://onfinance.org

DISCLAIMER:
This channel is not affiliated with any financial institution. The videos on this channel are for entertainment purposes only and do not constitute financial advice. Those seeking investment advice should seek out a registered professional. Patrick is not responsible for investment actions taken by viewers and his content should not be used as a basis for investment.

snippet.title: Dhruv Rathee
snippet.description:
I love breaking down complex issues in simple words. 

Learning, Awareness and Education is the purpose of this channel. Dhruv Rathee is a Youtube educator whose expertise lies in doing simplified and objective explainers of complex topics. Educate yourself on important things which matter in your life and learn how you can make the world a better place for yourself and for everyone else! 

Be the change you want to see. Join in by clicking the Subscribe button! :)

snippet.title: Graham Stephan
snippet.description:
As a 34 year old real estate investor who started working in real estate shortly after turning 18, with over $120,000,000 in residential sales since 2008, I've created this channel to share my successes, failures, and experiences in real estate, personal finance, and investing news. I'm also obsessed with frugality and credit card churning...a lot. So Subscribe! Because all the cool kids are doing it.  

Feel free to follow me on Snapchat / Instagram: GPStephan

snippet.title: Explaining Economics Like You're Five
snippet.description:
Welcome to the channel where economics is explained like you're five.

Ever wonder what inflation actually is? Why money seems to magically disappear? Or what in the world a central bank even does? We break down all those confusing, grown-up economics topics using kid-sized logic, funny examples, and plain English — no degrees or calculators required.

If you’ve ever nodded along in a money conversation while secretly screaming inside, this channel is your safe space.

Subscribe and get smarter about the economy, one juice-box-level explanation at a time.
